description: Fixed-semantics data-volume scaling contract rooted at the generation-3 champion.

starting_champion.role: immutable self-play teacher, training initialization, and promotion opponent for every primary stage

stages.name: matched-1k
stages.reason: The historical generation-3 1k dataset used the generation-2 checkpoint as teacher and is not a matched reference for this contract.

mcts.move_selection: maximum root visits, then mean value, then row-major coordinate

dataset.value_target: terminal outcome from the recorded position's side-to-move perspective

opponents: previous retained stage candidate when one exists

promotion.rule: candidate wins / 40 games >= 0.55; draws remain in the denominator

meaningful_scaling_gain.rule: candidate wins / 40 games >= 0.55; draws remain in the denominator

saturation.rule: After the required matched-1k and 5k stages, stop before the next optional stage when the latest stage fails the meaningful-scaling-gain gate. Retain and report the failed stage as saturation evidence.

stretch_50k.rule: Run only if 25k passes the meaningful-scaling-gain gate and projected self-play is at most 12 hours with projected retained external storage at most 25 GiB.

seeds.game_seed_derivation: python-random.Random(batch_seed).getrandbits(64), once per game in zero-based game-index order
seeds.decision_seed_derivation: python-random.Random(game_seed).randrange(2**64), once per ply in move order

reporting.evaluation_artifacts: One path/SHA-256/byte record for every fixed-opponent evaluation; the collection is not limited to the generation promotion evaluation.
required: teacher, dataset-manifest, every dataset-shard, candidate-checkpoint, and evaluation-artifact SHA-256
self-play, dataset-build, training, evaluation, and total wall seconds
policy support, entropy, and maximum-probability distributions
value-target counts and fractions for -1, 0, and 1
file counts and byte sizes by self-play, dataset, training, evaluation, and total
loss history, best epoch, promotion result, and all fixed-baseline results

manifest.external_uri: Required non-empty durable base URI before pruning any local artifact.
manifest.inventory_complete: True only after the categorized inventory and its canonical SHA-256 were captured.
manifest.inventory_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing categories, files, and bytes.

storage_attestation.timing: Added only after a separate process verifies every inventoried object at external_uri.

manifest.pruning_ready: Derived by reporting; true only when inventory_complete and a matching verified-storage attestation both validate.
manifest.validation: All four categories are required and non-empty; object paths are unique canonical relative paths; SHA-256 values are 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; byte sizes are non-negative integers; and every category/global file and byte rollup must equal its objects before inventory_complete is accepted.

git: best candidate checkpoint for every attempted stage
evaluation reports, including rejected and saturated stages
external_durable_storage: latest.pt and other non-best checkpoints needed for recovery
retention.policy: Do not duplicate multi-gigabyte reconstructable raw games and shards in Git. Training records inventory_complete and an inventory SHA-256 but never asserts external persistence. After transfer, a separate storage verifier must attest the matching URI and inventory digest. Reporting derives pruning readiness only from both valid records; local scratch copies must not be pruned otherwise. Never omit a rejected or saturated stage's report or best checkpoint.

invariants.primary_comparison: Only game count and the explicitly assigned stage/root seeds vary. Every stage independently uses the same teacher and training initialization; candidates never become later-stage teachers.
invariants.diagnostics: Any changed teacher, architecture, encoding, search, training, or evaluation setting is a separately labeled diagnostic and is excluded from the primary scaling curve.
